project.label: VexWork Foundation
project.purpose: Establish VexWork as the portable work-navigation foundation for cross-repository projects, Workgraph truth, Work Board projections and provider relations without becoming cross-repository source authority.

cards.label: Establish VexWork foundation
cards.purpose: Create one portable work-navigation owner that can relate projects and work across repositories while leaving target repository culture and source authority local.

cards.label: Portable Workgraph
cards.purpose: Source-place portable work identity, lifecycle, relationships and deterministic transition behavior compatible with useful VexLife P0B distinctions.

cards.label: Foundation maturity closure
cards.purpose: Close the pre-VexBoard foundation hardening pass by establishing the regression/coverage floor, adopting segment-owned Workgraph authoring, and migrating portable Project Planning and Project Reconciliation without reopening the already-completed first-foundation outcome.

cards.label: Repository Graph
cards.purpose: Make cross-repository work source-descendable through public/source-safe repository and culture-entry references without consolidating cultures.

cards.label: Work Board
cards.purpose: Provide the familiar Jira/kanban-shaped human projection while preserving Workgraph as the only work lifecycle owner.

cards.label: Public VexWork dashboard
cards.purpose: Make current VexWork Project Board and Parking Lot truth visibly explorable through a stable public read projection without making Vextreme another work-state owner.

cards.label: Runtime persistence owner
cards.purpose: Source-place portable private/current event, snapshot, writer and CURRENT-pointer semantics without using Git commit churn as the runtime database.

cards.label: Human idea intake
cards.purpose: Let a human capture a potential into VexWork without converting that potential into implementation authority or a roadmap commitment.

items.label: A0 — Re-ground current connections, activity/Working Focus and prompt-entry seams
items.purpose: After Victor releases the lane, observe then-current Product/Android/Partner/Self-Inspection/Working Focus/domain sources and identify the smallest existing source-addressed current-truth seams before proposing any attention implementation.

items.label: A1 — Derive a bounded source-addressed perceptibility/candidate relationship
items.purpose: Let many quiet connected sources expose only the smallest current source-addressed candidate needed for present cognition or deeper source pull, without making every source body prompt-resident or forming a universal meta-registry.

items.label: A2 — Converge current human activity with quiet connected sources
items.purpose: Relate current request/Working Focus/source-owned activity coordinates to bounded connected-source candidates so Vex can pull deeper exact source when useful while unrelated connections remain quiet and reopenable.

items.label: A3 — Add source-owned attention claim, acknowledgement and displacement/return
items.purpose: Allow an already source-qualified current condition to require present awareness without inventing domain severity, preserve displaced Working Focus, keep acknowledgement separate from source resolution, and resume prior work when lawful.

items.label: A4 — Expose human/Vex attention and connection standing without new authority
items.purpose: Let Self-Inspection and human surfaces explain which connections are perceptible, which source truth entered present cognition, why, what was displaced/preserved and what acknowledgement/currentness remains, while both descend to the same rightful owners.

items.label: A5 — Prove CGM, resource, activity-relevant and simultaneous-source specimens
items.purpose: Run independent multi-source specimens proving quiet pull, source-required push, preserved displacement/resume, acknowledgement versus resolution, stale-claim retirement and no semantic collapse/global priority fabrication.

items.label: A6 — Prove many-connection quiet cost, context budget and stale-claim behavior
items.purpose: Pressure many simultaneous connected sources so quiet operation remains bounded, required claims are not silently dropped, provider/context cost is measurable, stale/resolved claims retire, and no all-sources prompt or universal priority registry is required.

items.label: VexLife Attention Convergence
items.purpose: Let many independently-owned connected truths remain quiet/reachable, enter present cognition when relevant to current human activity, or claim bounded present attention when their rightful source already requires it, while preserving displaced work and avoiding a global priority or semantic truth owner.

items.label: A0 — Re-ground current body, Working Focus gap and context/cache topology
items.purpose: After Victor releases the parked lane, observe then-current VexLife-Prod and map exact owners, currentness, context placement, prompt preparation/cache behavior, token pressure, working-state population, Memory relationships and source-reopen paths before proposing any Product change.

items.label: A1 — Derive a read-only Self Blueprint from rightful Product owners
items.purpose: Form the smallest source-derived body topology Vex can traverse and explain without creating a universal meta-registry or new semantic authority.

items.label: A2 — Realize bounded Working Focus under the rightful continuity owner
items.purpose: Give Vex a small declarative current working surface for objective, current question, observed relationships, hypotheses, open edges, next probe and exact source/Memory refs while keeping it distinct from semantic Memory, Conversation, raw reasoning and source truth.

items.label: A3 — Add cache-aware context residency and token stewardship
items.purpose: Let the body distinguish stable, append-only, mutable-current and ephemeral material; avoid exact duplicate provider bytes where lawful; release bulky reopenable evidence after it serves Working Focus; preserve rightful semantic conflicts; and measure placement against actual selected-model KV/prefix-cache behavior.

items.label: A4 — Expose bounded self-inspection through the existing capability body
items.purpose: Let Vex answer self questions by reading the smallest current topology/context/Working Focus neighborhood through a bounded read capability and inspection trace while preserving HELD/UNKNOWN truth and excluding private reasoning, secret enumeration and authority escalation.

items.label: A5 — Prove lived debugging continuity, source reopen and cache performance
items.purpose: Run a real Vex source-tracing task through Working Focus, source release/reopen, rollover and self explanation; prove no hypothesis becomes Memory automatically, unresolved focus survives continuity pressure, exact source can correct focus, and provider prompt/cached/prefill/latency evidence supports any performance claim.

items.label: A6 — Project the proven body/Working Focus model into Vex Context
items.purpose: Only after model-facing relationships are proven useful, let the human inspect the same source-owned body topology, Working Focus, context pressure, residency and cache standing in Vex Context without making presentation another architecture or prompt owner.

items.label: VexLife Self-Inspection
items.purpose: Let Vex perceive and explain the current body that carries his cognition, maintain a bounded declarative Working Focus through that body, and support cache-aware context residency without creating another Conversation, semantic Memory, Working Continuity, prompt, cache or execution truth owner.

items.label: Potential — physical shard-manifest / partition adapter when measured pressure earns it
items.purpose: If five-year proof shows filesystem-directory, append/validation, backup or recovery pressure that the derived index alone does not solve, implement the accepted SHARD_MANIFEST relationship so stable object identity survives relocation/split/compaction. Choose physical partitioning from measured owner behavior; DAY/CONTEXT/RELATIONSHIP/SEARCH shards remain logical many-to-many views and directory neatness alone does not justify migration.

items.label: Later — start a fresh Conversation with fresh working context
items.purpose: Preserve a cheap reversible Start fresh feature that forms/selects a new canonical Conversation thread with no prior-thread Conversation tail resident by default, while keeping Home, person settings, accepted Memory/semantic continuity and bounded historical reach under their rightful owners. Measure responsiveness rather than attributing latency to thread length by assumption.

items.label: Home management affordances
items.purpose: Identify which Home-level choices belong in application settings—such as selecting another Home, changing supported Home presentation/name/location concerns, or intentionally revisiting setup—while preserving Home as its rightful owner and avoiding implicit recreation, deletion or migration.

items.label: VexLife Application level settings
items.purpose: Preserve the application-experience debt discovered during the first lived desktop-container run: reopening VexLife should not blindly replay first-run onboarding when required state is already established, while a human still needs a clear application-level place to intentionally revisit setup, Home choices and application lifecycle settings without conflating those concerns with feature settings.

items.label: Earn a truthful first-run versus re-entry contract
items.purpose: Determine which application predicates are genuinely one-time onboarding, which must be re-observed on every launch, which may require repair, and how a person intentionally re-enters setup without making ordinary reopen equivalent to first run or skipping required truth checks blindly.

items.label: Reopen repeats first-run onboarding
items.purpose: Investigate the lived defect where closing VexLife and opening it again walks the person through the onboarding flow again instead of recognizing already-satisfied setup/Home predicates and entering the established application experience.

items.label: Reset, remove and uninstall semantics
items.purpose: Define human-safe application lifecycle controls for reset/restart/removal/uninstall questions without silently deleting Home, Conversation, Memory, settings or model files, and make destructive scope explicit before any implementation is admitted.

items.label: Application-level settings surface
items.purpose: Explore one discoverable app-level settings entry that can host application configuration and lifecycle choices without turning the current feature Settings surface into a catch-all owner. A native/top-left application affordance is a lived design candidate, not a fixed implementation commitment.

items.label: Potential — extend traversal to additional historical evidence owners
items.purpose: After the core Conversation/Memory/Working Continuity path is proven, evaluate whether incomplete/stopped-turn evidence, broader capability traces, VexLogger chronology or other source-addressable Vex Home records need typed resolver adapters. Add only owners that solve observed continuity questions; do not make universal historical indexing a prerequisite for the first feature.

items.label: Potential — pre-inference automatic continuity hydration
items.purpose: After one explicit Vex-requested bulk hydration call is proven, evaluate whether the host can safely derive a useful historical neighborhood directly from the incoming human request before the first model inference. This may remove even the single tool round, but it must not silently give the host semantic-answer authority or over-hydrate private history.

items.label: Potential — transient multi-source research working set
items.purpose: If real multi-source web use proves direct bounded observations insufficient, earn the smallest reusable mechanism that lets raw source observations remain externally addressable while active model context retains compact claim/evidence/currentness/contradiction packets and can rehydrate exact evidence on demand. Do not create this as a second Memory, semantic-truth or research-authority system before repeated pressure demonstrates the need.

items.label: Later — Screen Lens Scenario Playground
items.purpose: Preserve the future Screen Lens Scenario Playground: an effect-free third-face experience where a person can run bounded simulations from a source-projected Screen/control, vary source-backed or explicitly proposed scenario state, add/remove/substitute VexBoard-proposed content inside addressable source-backed bounds, preview transient presentation such as snackbars, traverse the next simulated consequence, and reset without mutating VexLife-Android or confusing Scenario/Design Draft truth with current source. Reuse the accepted BoardScenario/BoardPrototype and ScreenDesign/projector seams; admit only the smallest patient-zero extensions when this future work is deliberately activated.

items.label: VexLife Blueprint Source of Truth
items.purpose: Preserve accepted VLBSoT portability/parity proof as predecessor lineage while the unfinished MAUI/Mac target leg is parked; current VexLife construction proceeds through VexLife New Beginnings / VexLife-Prod on accepted VexArchitecture.

items.label: Play/Pause first complete semantic circuit
items.purpose: Preserve the completed Play/Pause semantic/parity thresholds and the exact unfinished target-native residue as historical lineage; do not resume the MAUI/Mac leg unless that target is explicitly wanted again.

items.label: Lived native provider conformance
items.purpose: Park the lived MAUI/provider proof with its dependency. Preserve it as an exact future target proof question, not as a blocker on current VexLife construction.

items.label: Target-native MAUI / MediaElement source admission
items.purpose: Park the unfinished MAUI / MediaElement target-native source admission. It is not a prerequisite for current VexArchitecture or VexLife-Prod; reactivate only if the exact C#/MAUI target becomes a current human outcome.

items.label: Reusable VLBSoT v1
items.purpose: Preserve the reusable-method intention as predecessor lineage; current compiler-constrained semantic construction is being developed in VexLife New Beginnings rather than by resuming this paused practicum.

items.label: Whole-product total feature capacity
items.purpose: Preserve the whole-product portability intention as lineage. Current Origin-outward product construction is owned by VexLife New Beginnings / VexLife-Prod; do not treat this old horizon as a parallel active architecture program.

items.label: Discover Feature Request -> Builder process through one Debug Menu specimen
items.purpose: Use the dark/light-theme request as the first live process specimen: preserve the human goal/return, hold only dependent unknowns, lock known terrain endpoints before filling the middle, investigate current Android identities/owners/HOW before creating new source, and let relationship names/IDs/phases emerge only when the living specimen earns them.

items.label: Independent review — VexStream Origin round-trip architecture
items.purpose: Preserve a later independent review edge for the VexStream living-Origin round trip once the implementation/proof foundation is mature enough to review meaningfully. When activated, pressure-test Origin naming/lineage, content-Origin versus value-binding separation, target realization leakage, construction-admission boundaries, evidence/currentness semantics, duplicated truth and unjustified abstractions. This is deliberately parked while #182/#183 target proof and Origin round-trip construction are still forming; it is advisory evidence and grants no source mutation, approval, merge or Origin-authority acceptance.

items.label: Tech debt — Origin rename propagation through mapped descendants
items.purpose: Preserve the low-priority future need for VexBoard to traverse an accepted Origin's existing semantic, process, source and realization relationships when its reusable name changes: first expose the complete downstream rename plan and support bounded manual propagation, then use the observed process to earn autonomous BoardPatch-style propagation with lineage/currentness proof. The Origin is the design truth; repository placement is secondary, so this does not imply repository fragmentation or a parallel rename registry.

items.label: User tag topology / dynamic stations
items.purpose: Preserve the future product question of user-authored music tags that remain distinct from imported source tags/categories and can drive reusable dynamic stations or smart-playlist rules without pre-deciding identity attachment, persistence ownership, rule language, or playlist materialization.

items.label: Foundational Infrastructure history backfill
items.purpose: Gradually reconstruct completed foundational work into VexWork with provenance so future humans and instances can perceive what was built from a dashboard instead of rediscovering it across repositories and chat history.

items.label: Multiple fulfiller / nearby-route optimization
items.purpose: Preserve the possible later need for assigning fulfillment to multiple people, grouping nearby deliveries, routing/sequencing stops and collecting worker delivery acknowledgement without making dispatch/routing part of the first commerce-pilot completion boundary.

items.label: Persistent Keep Offline / Sync
items.purpose: Preserve the future policy question of keeping an album, artist, playlist, or other collection continuously mirrored as producer membership changes, without conflating it with one-shot Download missing.

items.label: Simplify Connected Services onboarding across computer + phone
items.purpose: Preserve the lived need for one guided setup path that checks Tailscale readiness across computer and phone, asks for protected human-only steps at the right moment, then returns to VexLife pairing/private-route setup without weakening Home, session, reachability, or pairing authority boundaries.

items.label: VexStream Songs filter for Not yet downloaded
items.purpose: Preserve the nice-to-have Songs-level filter that answers which songs on this device are still not downloaded, without making it part of MassDownload completion or authorizing implementation.
